name: DeskcommCRM
description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
one_liner: A customer-chat CRM where AI agents answer, qualify, and sell to customers over WhatsApp automatically, running on your own server instead of paying for Intercom or Kommo.
buyer: A small business owner (especially in Brazil or another WhatsApp-first market) who sells through WhatsApp chats and is currently paying monthly for Kommo- or Intercom-style tools.
business_use_cases: A local retailer or clinic auto-qualifies WhatsApp leads overnight so a human only steps in once a customer is ready to buy.
An agency resells 'done-for-you WhatsApp sales bot setup' to small businesses that don't have technical staff to configure it themselves.
A hosting/VPS provider bundles one-click DeskcommCRM deployments as a value-add for small-business customers, as the project already does with HostGator.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting and setup for non-technical small-business owners who don't want to touch a VPS
White-label it as a WhatsApp sales-bot agency service sold to local businesses

steal_this: Set it up on a cheap VPS this weekend, wire it to one real WhatsApp Business number for a friend's shop, and sell the working demo as a $99/mo managed service to other local shops.
